fred_states_note: SEVEN, not the three the brief assumed. http_error also covers an unknown/renamed series id (FRED answers 400). FRED's '.' missing marker is classified as a real observation of absence (empty), never a parse failure. Enumerated by reading the write path.
finnhub_states_note: Different union from FMP on purpose: no array endpoints here so no empty-array state, and it has unknown_symbol (an empty profile OBJECT) which FMP expresses as an empty array. http_error covers both a 401 bad token and a 429 exhausted free tier.
sole_consumer_refuses_empty_note: LITERALLY TRUE BUT CANNOT FIRE, which changes the severity upward. app/jobs/handlers.py:_run_equity_backfill does return {available:false, reason:'no tickers resolved'} on an empty list. But the watchlist (_WATCHLIST_CORE + _THEME_UNIVERSE = 63 symbols, measured) is unioned in unconditionally BEFORE the liquid legs, so a vendor outage never produced an empty universe for that guard to catch. It produced a plausible SHORT one that backfilled the wrong symbols and reported success. The prior seat's fail-safe reading does not hold. Fixed by refusing at the assembler.
getattr_sizing_note: 138 getattr(x, attr, DEFAULT) calls (third positional arg only) under app/, tests excluded. Zero local rebindings of the getattr builtin, so no false positives from shadowing. 49 are getattr(settings|get_settings(), ...) = config-default. Hand-classified the 28 with a non-None/bool/empty default: 20 config-default, 6 claim-default, 2 structural adapters. The 6 claim-defaults: app/intelligence/news_feed.py:48 getattr(resp,'status',200) treats a missing status as HTTP 200 (fail-open); app/governance/licensing.py:287 and :313 classify an atom with no family as Family.reference for a LICENSING decision; app/marketdata/microstructure.py:718,719,744 turn a missing book size / trade size into a fabricated 0 that enters imbalance and volume math. NOT extrapolated: the 92 None/False/''-defaulted sites are a different population and need their own read. Not fixed in this lane.

All 21 changed .py files re-parsed against the 3.12 grammar (ast feature_version) — zero incompatibilities. Provider tests re-run under a plugin that raises on any non-loopback socket connect, across both FMP_API_KEY unset and set-to-junk: 192 passed, no verdict changed by either variable. additional_defects_found_and_fixed: app/universe/sync.py mass-delisted the ENTIRE universe off one FMP failure: fetch_stock_list returned [] on any error, everything absent from `incoming` was set is_active=False with its alias era closed, and the function returned available:true with a delisted count in the thousands. Durable destructive mutation driven by a fabricated empty. HIGHEST SEVERITY finding of the lane.
fmp.fetch_quotes cached a fabricated absence: a batch-quote 5xx wrote None ('known absent') for every requested symbol, blanking the whole watchlist for the cache TTL.

fred.latest/series wrote failures into the 3h in-process cache, pinning a macro series blank long after FRED recovered — directly beneath a comment promising failures were never persisted (true of Redis, false of the process cache beside it).

equity_universe._extract_symbols_from_holdings read symbol/ticker but not `asset`; FMP /etf/holdings answers {symbol: <the ETF>, asset: <the holding>} on some responses, so a full 500-row SPY payload yielded the fund's own ticker rather than its holdings and looked exactly like an empty fund.

leave_behind.item: fmp.fetch_splits and fmp.fetch_splits_calendar still return [] on failure. They feed the split-correction backfill in app/jobs/equity_deep_daily_backfill.py, which DOES mutate durable state: a vendor outage reads as 'no splits' and leaves prices unadjusted. Internals were migrated to _fetch_list but the public contract is unchanged, because the consumer is outside this lane and adding an uncalled _result variant would only be a dormant mechanism.

Test-suite hermeticity is unswept. Two tests were found firing live vendor requests (FMP movers, FRED rates board) by running 10 test files under a socket guard that raises on non-loopback connects; roughly 90 further test files were never swept. CI has network, so CI green does not prove hermeticity. The guard is 60 lines and lives at the session scratchpad as nonet.py (deliberately NOT committed: wiring it into CI without a full sweep would red an unknown number of pre-existing tests).
